reason: A read-only boundary-window audit compared the floating Rasterio window transform against the integer pixel grid. round_offsets().round_lengths() rounded column/row lengths to nearest and could omit pixel centers at the polygon extent. The initial pair was deterministic but used an under-sized raster window, so its counts are preserved as historical and will not be used as final evidence. The final frozen producer expands bounds by one pixel and uses floor-start/ceil-stop integer windows before masking.
